annotations.title: Check the BFG deposit guarantee of a bank

description: Use to check if the BFG deposit guarantee includes a bank or a credit union. Check whether a Polish bank or credit union (SKOK) is on the list of entities covered by the deposit guarantee of the Bankowy Fundusz Gwarancyjny (BFG), by name, trade name (e.g. "Inteligo") or website. Without query: counts of commercial banks, cooperative banks, credit unions and entities in bankruptcy (series finwire_bfg_guarantee_monitor) with history and latest changes, and the guarantee limit (EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank) with its PLN equivalent at the latest NBP rate. Branches of banks from other EU countries are covered by their home-country scheme, so no match for them is expected.

query.description: Bank or credit union name (min. 3 characters), trade name or website.
